versions.content: Providing Logging Information. Type: Valid Description: Logging shall enable Applications to provide logging informatio n. The logging information shall include information about its severity. Rationale: While developing applications, it is important to get additional information what is going on internally of an application. Use Case: Getting internal information of an a pplication, e.g.: Variable values, the current internal state of a state machine, and other information. Applies to: FO Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
